title: OperatingModeDefinition
description: Formal schema for discrete operating modes within the Design / Policy Plane.

mode_id.description: Standard operational mode identifier, or custom domain mode.

description.description: Operational context and posture of this mode.

allowed_operations.description: List of UoW contract operation IDs permitted during this mode.

forbidden_operations.description: Explicitly blacklisted operations that fail closed in this mode.

required_sensor_namespaces.description: Observation namespaces that must be actively reporting valid data.

fallback_mode.description: Degradation target mode if invariants or sensors are threatened.

entry_criteria.description: State and observation predicates required to enter this mode.

exit_criteria.description: Predicates required to exit this mode.

max_duration_seconds.description: Optional timeout after which system must force fallback mode.
